parent_objective: audit action-only late-reveal outcome probe before new source changes
blocked_by: M1401 found action sensitivity but no outcome-critical rows and no preferred near-boundary candidates
supersedes: running another late-reveal outcome probe without a route decision

public_gates: M1402 must audit M1401 before new source changes or training
M1402 must classify action-only evidence and near-boundary sparsity
M1402 must choose reveal-grid redesign, mild warmup stimulus design, simulator/task extension, or synthesis
M1402 must not train, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, export a training corpus, or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not count action-only rows as outcome evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: classifies M1401 action-only late-reveal outcome result and selects the next route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if audit treats action-only rows as outcome evidence
stop if near-boundary sparsity is ignored
stop if next route repeats the same late-reveal grid without a new evidence axis
fallback_plan: route to mild warmup stimulus design if late reveal alone is insufficient
route to simulator/task extension if obstacle pressure cannot be tightened with existing config
route to branch synthesis if no credible public next route remains

admission_evidence: M1401 found 1464 action-critical rows but 0 accepted outcome rows
M1401 found 16 broad near-boundary candidates and 0 preferred near-boundary candidates
M1401 did not train, promote, use private holdout, export corpus, or change actor inputs
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: no training or corpus export is admitted from action-only evidence

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1402 must treat M1401 as action-only and cannot count hidden/action differences without outcome gaps as history necessity.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Process audit over M1401 no-training outcome artifacts.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If late-reveal outcome evidence is absent, route to a new source/task design before training.
allowed_claims: no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, high-fidelity, paper-level result, or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A process audit can determine the next route after M1401 shows action sensitivity but no outcome-critical near-boundary history evidence.
success_criteria: audit classifies action-only evidence and near-boundary sparsity
audit chooses a next route without corpus export, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input expansion
failure_criteria: audit routes directly to training or claim expansion
decision_rule: M1402 passes if it audits M1401 and chooses a redesign or synthesis route before any training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, or actor-input expansion.
